justification: Display-only copy fix on one brief card: the Title & Ownership card repeated 'not strata' across three rows and leaked the internal field name 'Plan Label'. No data, engine, or API changes; freehold lots now get one prose sentence and strata lots get properly labelled rows.

pre_impl.existing_data: Renders the existing strata DataField already streamed to the page; no new data touched.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: A contradictory record (is_strata false but strata_type set) renders the STRATA detail view so information is never hidden.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Pure render change applied at view time; nothing stored.

functions.name: StrataDisplay
functions.input: the strata DataField value dict already held by the page
functions.output: one prose sentence for freehold lots or labelled rows for strata lots
functions.if_none: null plan label simply omits the plan sentence; unknown scheme type falls back to the humanised enum value

break_it.scenario: Contradictory upstream record says is_strata false while strata_type says apartment, and the freehold sentence hides the strata signal
break_it.what_happens: A buyer could read a strata-flagged unit as clean freehold title in the ownership card
break_it.how: StrataDisplay treats EITHER signal as strata (is_strata true OR a non-not_strata type) so the detail view wins on contradiction
break_it.repro: render brief with strata value {is_strata: false, strata_type: 'apartment'} and confirm the strata rows show
